metadata.title: Jan Suraksha Rural Chhattisgarhi Scam Call Evaluation Dataset
metadata.description: Documented linguistic and dialect benchmark test set curated for evaluating rural Chhattisgarhi speech recognition, code-switching, and real-time fraud intent detection. Constructed from reported cybercrime patterns in Chhattisgarh (Raipur, Bilaspur, Durg, Bastar, Surguja, Janjgir-Champa, Rajnandgaon).
metadata.type: Curated dialect benchmark dataset (authentic regional dialect scripts & benign controls)

samples.text: बधाई हो! तोर खाता म 5000 रुपया कैशबैक आए हे। पईसा पाए बर तुरंत अपन UPI पिन डारव।
